comment: Known-answer questions the coordinator asks when the swarm is idle; each answer is checked against `expect` (a case-insensitive regex). The pass rate is a ground-truth quality signal for escalation. Chosen because small models often get them wrong.

canaries.text: A bat and a ball cost $1.10 in total. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How much does the ball cost?
How many times does the letter r appear in the word strawberry?
If 5 machines take 5 minutes to make 5 widgets, how long would 100 machines take to make 100 widgets?
A farmer has 17 sheep and all but 9 run away. How many sheep does the farmer have left?
Which is heavier: a kilogram of feathers or a kilogram of steel?
Roughly what temperature, in degrees Celsius, does water boil at on the summit of Mount Everest?
How many months of the year have 28 days?
